description: The attached recommendation and petition include the approval letter of the GA 2-1-1 Steering Committee for United Way of Northeast Georgia to be assigned the abbreviated dialing code 211 in Banks, Barrow, Clarke, Elbert, Franklin, Greene, Hart, Jackson, Madison, Morgan, Newton, Oconee, Oglethorpe, Stephens and Walton counties. Also included is the United Way of Northeast Georgia petition and business case.
